title: Prayer (Salah) and Pain — Safe Positions, Respectful Care

hook.en: Five times a day, millions of people stand, bow, kneel and sit on their heels. For a patient with knee, hip or back pain, or after surgery, prayer can become a source of fear. A physiotherapist who understands the movements, and respects the practice, can help the patient pray in comfort and safely.
hook.ur: Din mein paanch baar karoron log khade hote hain, jhukte hain, ghutnon ke bal baithte hain aur eriyon par baithte hain. Ghutne, hip ya kamar ke dard wale ya surgery ke baad mareez ke liye namaaz dar ka sabab ban sakti hai. Jo physiotherapist in harkaton ko samjhe aur is amal ka ehtram kare woh mareez ko aaram aur hifazat se namaaz parhne mein madad kar sakta hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll break the prayer into its joint movements, spot which ones strain a painful knee, hip or back, offer practical options while the patient decides with their own scholar, and speak respectfully.
goal.ur: End tak aap namaaz ko uski joint ki harkaton mein todenge, pehchanenge ke kaun si harkat dukhte ghutne, hip ya kamar par bojh dalti hai, amali options dein ge jabke mareez apne aalim se faisla kare, aur izzat ke saath baat karenge.

text.en: **A clear division of roles.** What prayer requires is a matter for the patient and their own religious scholar. Many scholars teach that prayer can be offered seated, with a chair, or in modified ways when a person is unwell or in pain. Your role is different and just as important: you understand how the body moves, you find which movement is the problem, and you help the patient meet their practice safely. You never give a religious ruling, and you never tell a patient to stop praying.
text.ur: **Zimmedariyon ki saaf taqseem.** Namaaz ka taqaza kya hai, yeh mareez aur uske apne aalim ka maamla hai. Bohat se ulama sikhate hain ke bimari ya dard mein namaaz baith kar, kursi par, ya badle hue tareeqay se parhi ja sakti hai. Aap ka kirdar alag aur utna hi ahem hai: aap samajhte hain jism kaise hilta hai, aap dhoondte hain ke kaun si harkat masla hai, aur mareez ko apna amal mehfooz tareeqay se poora karne mein madad dete hain. Aap kabhi mazhabi hukm nahi dete, aur kabhi mareez ko namaaz chhorne ko nahi kehte.

text.en: Think of yourself as an **interpreter**. An interpreter does not change what a speaker says; they help the message cross the gap. In the same way, you do not change the prayer. You help the body carry it across the gap that pain or surgery has made.
text.ur: Khud ko **tarjuman** sochein. Tarjuman bolne wale ki baat badalta nahi; paighaam ko fasle ke paar pohanchata hai. Isi tarah aap namaaz badalte nahi. Aap jism ko woh fasla paar karne mein madad dete hain jo dard ya surgery ne bana diya hai.

title.en: What each position asks of the body
title.ur: Har position jism se kya maangti hai

headers.en: Who may struggle, and what to try
headers.ur: Kis ko mushkil ho sakti hai, aur kya aazmayein

rows.en: Stand still, balance, carry body weight through the hips, knees and ankles
rows.ur: Ruk kar khade hona, balance, hips, ghutnon aur takhnon se wazan uthana

rows.en: Balance problems, painful hip or knee: lean against a wall, a stool nearby, or pray standing with support
rows.ur: Balance ke masle, dukhta hip ya ghutna: deewar se tek, qareeb stool, ya sahare ke saath khade hokar

rows.en: Bend forward from the hips, hands on the knees, back neutral or slightly rounded
rows.ur: Kulhon se aage jhukna, haath ghutnon par, kamar neutral ya halki gol

rows.en: Back pain, osteoporosis: hinge from the hips, hands on the thighs, bow less deeply if the back hurts
rows.ur: Kamar dard, osteoporosis: kulhon se jhukein, haath raano par, dard ho to kam gehra jhukein

rows.en: Deep bend of the hips and knees, ankles and toes bent, weight through the hands, knees and forehead
rows.ur: Hips aur ghutnon ka gehra mur jana, takhne aur ungliyan mudi hui, wazan haathon, ghutnon aur peshani par

rows.en: Knee osteoarthritis, a replaced knee or hip, ankle stiffness: a raised surface or a chair adaptation, a towel roll behind the knee, less depth
rows.ur: Ghutne ka osteoarthritis, badla hua ghutna ya hip, takhne ki akdan: oonchi satah ya kursi ki tabdeeli, ghutne ke peechay tauliye ka roll, kam gehra

rows.en: Deepest knee bend, ankles flexed, weight over the heels
rows.ur: Ghutnon ka sab se gehra mur jana, takhne mudi hui, wazan eriyon par

rows.en: Painful knees, hip replacement, circulation problems: sit on a cushion or low stool, or in a chair
rows.ur: Dukhte ghutne, hip replacement, circulation ke masle: gaddi ya neechay stool par, ya kursi par

rows.en: The hardest part: push up from deep bend with the leg muscles and the arms
rows.ur: Sab se mushkil hissa: gehre mur-pan se taangon ke muscles aur bazuon se oopar uthna

rows.en: Weak thighs, pain on rising: push with the hands on the thighs or a firm surface, move slowly, build leg strength
rows.ur: Kamzor raanein, uthte waqt dard: haath raanon ya mazboot satah par, dheere, taangon ki taqat banayein

question.en: A 66-year-old man has right knee osteoarthritis. The knee hurts most in prostration and when rising from it. He asks you, "Is it permitted for me to pray on a chair?" What is the best response?
question.ur: 66 saal ke mareez ko dayen ghutne ka osteoarthritis hai. Ghutna sajde mein aur sajde se uthte waqt sab se zyada dukhta hai. Woh poochhta hai, "Kya mere liye kursi par namaaz parhna jaiz hai?" Behtareen jawab kya hai?

text.en: Tell him yes, it is permitted, so he should stop kneeling
text.ur: Kahein haan jaiz hai, isliye ghutne ke bal baithna chhor de

feedback.en: That is a religious ruling and it is not your role.
feedback.ur: Yeh mazhabi hukm hai aur aap ka kirdar nahi.

text.en: Say that this is a question for his own scholar, and offer to help him with whichever way he chooses
text.ur: Kahein ke yeh sawal uske apne aalim se poochhne ka hai, aur jo tareeqa woh chune us mein madad ki peshkash karein

feedback.en: Yes — you do not give rulings, and you can still make his chosen way comfortable and safe.
feedback.ur: Haan — aap hukm nahi dete, aur phir bhi uske chune hue tareeqay ko aaramdeh aur mehfooz bana sakte hain.

text.en: Tell him to keep kneeling because exercise is good for the knee
text.ur: Kahein ke ghutne ke bal baithta rahe kyunke exercise ghutne ke liye achi hai

feedback.en: Pushing through the pain ignores his needs and could harm the knee.
feedback.ur: Dard ke bawajood dabao uski zaroorat nazar-andaaz karta hai aur ghutne ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai.

question.en: Three weeks after a total knee replacement, a woman wants to return to praying on the floor. The surgeon has set a limit on how far she may bend the knee. What do you do?
question.ur: Total knee replacement ke teen haftay baad khatoon farsh par namaaz par wapas jana chahti hain. Surgeon ne ghutna mur'ne ki had tay ki hui hai. Aap kya karein?

text.en: Tell her she can never kneel again
text.ur: Kahein ke woh dobara kabhi ghutne ke bal nahi baith sakti

feedback.en: That is untrue for many people and removes hope.
feedback.ur: Bohat se logon ke liye yeh ghalat hai aur umeed khatam karta hai.

text.en: Work within the surgeon's limits and offer a chair or raised-surface option for now, progressing as healing allows
text.ur: Surgeon ki hadon ke andar kaam karein aur filhal kursi ya oonchi satah ka option dein, healing ke saath aage barhein

feedback.en: Yes — protect the repair now, and plan a gradual return as the surgeon and the knee allow.
feedback.ur: Haan — abhi marammat ki hifazat karein, aur surgeon aur ghutne ke ijazat ke saath tadreeji wapsi ka plan banayein.

text.en: Encourage her to bend as deeply as she can to gain range quickly
text.ur: Jaldi range pane ke liye jitna ho sake gehra mur'ne ki hausla afzai karein

feedback.en: Forcing deep bending early can damage the repair and cause pain and swelling.
feedback.ur: Shuru mein zor se gehra murna marammat ko nuqsan aur dard aur soojan de sakta hai.

question.en: A man with chronic low back pain says the worst part of prayer is the bow and the rise from sitting. What is a sensible first idea?
question.ur: Kamar ke musalsal dard wala mareez kehta hai ke namaaz ka sab se bura hissa ruku aur baithne se uthna hai. Pehla samajhdar khayal kya hai?

text.en: Tell him to avoid bending completely
text.ur: Usay bilkul jhukne se bachne ko kahein

feedback.en: Total avoidance is unnecessary, and it weakens the back further.
feedback.ur: Mukammal parhez zaroori nahi, aur kamar ko mazeed kamzor karta hai.

text.en: Give him a long list of back exercises and ignore prayer
text.ur: Kamar ki exercises ki lambi list dein aur namaaz nazar-andaaz karein

feedback.en: The prayer is what matters to him, so it must be part of the plan.
feedback.ur: Namaaz uske liye ahem hai, isliye plan ka hissa honi chahiye.

text.en: Teach him to hinge from the hips with his hands on his thighs, move slowly, and strengthen the thighs and hips for the rise
text.ur: Usay kulhon se jhukna, haath raanon par rakhna, dheere harkat karna sikhayein, aur uthne ke liye raanon aur kulhon ki taqat badhayein

feedback.en: Yes — moving the bend to the hips and using the hands and legs unloads the back.
feedback.ur: Haan — jhukao kulhon mein le jana aur haath aur taangein istemal karna kamar ka bojh kam karta hai.

title.en: Four steps for a respectful plan
title.ur: Izzat bhare plan ke chaar qadam

steps.title: Ask, do not assume
steps.detail: "Which movement of your prayer is hardest, and how do you pray now?" Listen before you suggest. || Poochhein, farz na karein

steps.title: Find the joint
steps.detail: Is it the knee in deep bend, the hip, the back in the bow, the ankle, or the rise? Test those movements gently in clinic. || Joint dhoondein

steps.title: Offer options, not orders
steps.detail: A chair, a raised surface, a cushion or low stool, a towel roll behind the knee, a hand-hold to rise. Let the patient choose, with their scholar. || Options dein, hukm nahi

steps.title: Build towards it
steps.detail: Strengthen the legs and hips, work on ankle and knee range within safe limits, and practise getting up and down so the patient can do more over time if they wish. || Us ki taraf barhein

text.en: **Telling a patient to stop praying because it hurts.** This damages trust and leaves the patient with a hard choice between pain and practice. The better move is to find which movement hurts, offer options and plan a gradual return where possible. Another mistake is to offer a religious ruling: it is outside your role, and your guess may be wrong.
text.ur: **Mareez ko kehna ke dard ki wajah se namaaz chhor do.** Isse bharosa tootta hai aur mareez ko dard aur amal ke beech mushkil intikhab par chhor deta hai. Behtar yeh hai ke dhoondein kaun si harkat dukhti hai, options dein aur jahan mumkin ho tadreeji wapsi ka plan banayein. Doosri ghalti mazhabi hukm dena hai: yeh aap ke kirdar se bahar hai, aur aap ka andaza ghalat ho sakta hai.

text.en: **Speak with warmth and respect.** For example: "Your prayer matters to you, and I want to help you do it with less pain. Which part is hardest? Let us find a way that your body can manage, and you can talk to your own scholar about what is right for you." Schedule appointments so that they do not clash with prayer times, and offer a quiet space and, where possible, a clean surface to pray in clinic.
text.ur: **Narmi aur izzat se baat karein.** Misaal: "Aap ke liye namaaz ahem hai, aur main chahta hoon ke aap isay kam dard ke saath adaa karein. Kaun sa hissa sab se mushkil hai? Aise tareeqay dhoondte hain jo aap ka jism sambhal sake, aur aap apne aalim se poochh lein ke aap ke liye kya durust hai." Appointments is tarah rakhein ke namaaz ke auqaat se na takrayein, aur clinic mein shant jagah aur, jahan mumkin ho, namaaz ke liye saaf satah dein.

question.en: Is the prayer itself good or bad for the joints?
question.ur: Kya namaaz khud joints ke liye achi hai ya buri?

answer.en: It depends on the person and the joint, and honestly the research is limited. Computer-model studies suggest the movements resemble mobility exercises and that angles matter for the back, but no study has measured the real forces on the knee during prostration. A Saudi study found that many patients with knee osteoarthritis adapt their prayer, for example by using a chair, and that function and quality of life were lower in long-term adapters. So the safest message is: do not scare people, do not promise miracles, and tailor the plan.
answer.ur: Yeh insaan aur joint par munhasir hai, aur sach yeh hai ke research mehdood hai. Computer-model studies ishara karti hain ke harkatein mobility exercises jaisi hain aur kamar ke liye angles ahem hain, lekin kisi study ne sajde mein ghutne par asal force nahi naapi. Ek Saudi study ne dekha ke ghutne ke osteoarthritis ke bohat se mareez apni namaaz mein tabdeeli karte hain, masalan kursi, aur lambe arsay se tabdeeli karne walon mein function aur zindagi ka mayaar kam tha. Isliye sab se mehfooz paighaam yeh hai: logon ko daraiye mat, mojizay ka wada na karein, aur plan har ek ke mutabiq banayein.

beats.patient: A 70-year-old woman with right hip replacement 8 weeks ago (surgeon allows full movement), left knee osteoarthritis, and weak thighs wants to pray on the floor again for her grandchildren's sake. She finds sujud painful on the left knee and cannot rise without help.
beats.assessment: The main problems are left knee pain in deep bend, weak leg muscles for the rise, and anxiety after hip replacement. Her goal is clear and meaningful.
beats.treatment: Strengthen thighs and hips with sit-to-stand and step work, practise a staged rise using a stable stool, use a towel roll or cushion for the knee, and let her choose between floor and chair adaptation with her scholar. Review pain and swelling the next day.
beats.reassess: After four weeks she rises with one hand on a stool and prays the sitting parts on a cushion, with less knee pain. The plan is updated as she gets stronger.

text.en: **Check for warning signs.** A hot swollen painful calf, sudden knee swelling, a locked knee, new weakness, numbness, or night pain needs a medical review before pushing movement. After surgery, always follow the surgeon's precautions (for example the hip-bend limits after some hip replacements) and do not force deep positions.
text.ur: **Warning signs dekhein.** Garam soojhi dard bhari pindli, achanak ghutne ki soojan, lock hua ghutna, nayi kamzori, sunn, ya raat ka dard ho to harkat badhane se pehle medical review chahiye. Surgery ke baad hamesha surgeon ki ehtiyaten manein (masalan kuch hip replacements ke baad hip mur'ne ki hadein) aur gehri positions zabardasti na karein.

text.en: An ergonomic study using digital human models of Muslim prayer movements suggested that the bow is the most demanding position for the low back and that proper knee and back angles may reduce strain; it is a simulation, not a trial. A Saudi cross-sectional study of people with knee osteoarthritis described how they modify prayer, such as using a chair, and reported lower function and quality of life with longer-term modification. No trial has yet measured knee forces during prostration.
text.ur: Digital human models ke zariye namaaz ki harkaton par ek ergonomic study ne ishara diya ke ruku neeche ki kamar ke liye sab se zyada taleebi position hai aur durust ghutne aur kamar ke angles se dabao kam ho sakta hai; yeh simulation hai, trial nahi. Ghutne ke osteoarthritis wale logon ki Saudi cross-sectional study ne bataya ke woh namaaz mein kaise tabdeeli karte hain, jaise kursi, aur lambe arsay ki tabdeeli ke saath function aur zindagi ka mayaar kam bataya. Abhi tak kisi trial ne sajde mein ghutne ki force nahi naapi.

text.en: **Ask, Find, Offer, Build.** Ask which movement is hard, find the joint, offer options and let the patient decide with their scholar, then build strength and range towards their goal.
text.ur: **Poochhein, Dhoondein, Options, Banayein.** Poochhein kaun si harkat mushkil hai, joint dhoondein, options dein aur mareez ko aalim ke saath faisla karne dein, phir apne maqsad ki taraf taqat aur range banayein.

summary.en: Break prayer into joint movements, find the one that hurts, and keep the plan respectful: you offer options, the patient decides with their scholar.
summary.ur: Namaaz ko joint ki harkaton mein todein, jo dukhti hai woh dhoondein, aur plan izzat bhara rakhein: aap options dete hain, mareez apne aalim ke saath faisla karta hai.

summary.en: Deep knee bend, the bow and the rise are the usual troublemakers; use a hip hinge, supports, cushions, raised surfaces and leg strengthening.
summary.ur: Ghutne ka gehra mur'na, ruku aur uthna aam masla hain; kulhon se jhukna, sahare, gaddiyan, oonchi satah aur taangon ki taqat istemal karein.

summary.en: After surgery follow the surgeon's limits, and never give a religious ruling or tell a patient to stop praying.
summary.ur: Surgery ke baad surgeon ki hadon par chalein, aur kabhi mazhabi hukm na dein ya mareez ko namaaz chhorne ko na kahein.

back.en: The patient, with their own religious scholar.

front.ur: Ruku mein kamar ka bojh kaise kam karein?

back.en: Hinge from the hips and rest the hands on the thighs.
back.ur: Kulhon se jhukein aur haath raanon par rakhein.

front.ur: Aap ko kya kabhi nahi karna?

back.en: Give a religious ruling, or tell a patient to stop praying.
back.ur: Mazhabi hukm dena, ya mareez ko namaaz chhorne ko kehna.
